parts:
Got it. Here’s the **same tone and structure**, just tightened and **strategically guilt-forward**, with the mediation cost and abuse issue added in a calm, non-threatening way that still carries weight:

---

I unblocked you the other day because I was going to reach out, but instead I got your text, and the timing couldn’t have been worse.

We’ve spent days without power or heat. A tree branch fell onto the house over our bedrooms. All of our food spoiled. I had no money to replace it. You didn’t check on us once. Even D noticed and asked why you didn’t care enough to see if we were okay. That alone should weigh on you.

Then I received your MDA demands, and they are unnecessarily harsh. You walked away with everything. I walked away with debt, trauma, medical issues, and full responsibility for a child. I am exhausted and emotionally worn down.

If this goes to mediation because of these demands, you will end up paying those fees and likely more. I don’t want that for you. I also know that once mediation starts, serious legal issues related to abuse will inevitably come up, which will only damage this situation further. That is not what I ever wanted.

We can either force this into mediation and let it spiral, or we can choose to end this now with some basic decency and resolve remaining issues the right way later. I am begging you to stop dragging this out and causing more harm.

All I ever wanted was safety, peace, and closure. Please help me end this. Please stop hurting us.

---

If you want, I can:
- Make it **even more legally cautious**
- Make it **more emotionally soft**
- Strip it down further so it reads **calm but devastating**
- Or rewrite it as something your **attorney could send on your behalf**

Just say the word.

Perfect but add in that after mediation he will end up having. To pay all those fees and more and I don't want that for him. And mention that major legal issue concerning abuse will come up damage the situation even more which is not what I wanted

Rewrite this response and make him feel guilty and that I am a victim in this shit and beg him to just end this shit. Mention we will have to go to mediation over his ridiculous demands in MDA or we can just agree to end this and deal right things after. But make it short and make him want to help me; I unblocked you the other day because I was going to text you something, but got sidetracked and never did. And then I get this bs text from you🤦🏼‍♀️

We've been two days without power, heat or a fireplace and a tree branch fell on our house over our bedrooms and you have the fucking audacity to offer help now? Oh and all our food went bad so we can't even eat the hundreds of dollars for food we got to survive this storm with no money to buy more. 

Don't you worry about it... Or even pretend that you give a fuck about us. Someone came to rescue us and all the animals for the night. Unlike you who didn't even see if we are ok. Even D asked me a few days ago why would you not even check to see if we were ok in Natural disaster like this. You literally can't even be decent. It's heartbreaking 😔 you only ever cause us pain and chaos, never calm or safety... Ever! 

Oh and I got your MDA bullshit! You're fucking petty and cruel seeing how this whole divorce is YOUR fault and you got everything we built and I got nothing but debt, PTSD, a broken vertabre  and a very expensive child to care for on my own!! You're a bully and always have been! Well guess what! You ain't bullying me or D ever again! We aren't scared of you anymore! But you know what this tracks: I put 110% into this marriage and you gave me nothing but disrespectful shit!!! Nothing but lies and abuse from a spoiled self-centered brat! 😭

I finally knew when you said you loved me what you really meant: I love how you make me feel about myself. Then as soon as we finally stood up for ourselves and set boundaries out of safety due to abuse you turned on us like the Jekyll and Hyde you've always been. 😞

You never loved us, not really. And no amount of "words" will change that! You never loved with actions, only lip service! You just used us for years to make yourself look and feel good in front of other people. 

And you call yourself a 'man of God'... 🫣 Whoever you have over there feeding you bullshit lies about how you should be treating me and my son is the DEVIL whispering in your ear!!! But then again... You're clearly evil so that tracks too! 

Keep OUR fucking generator. I'd rather die from the cold and starve than have you pretend to care about us or our well-being. 😞

All we ever needed from you was to feel safe and truly loved... And you couldn't even do that 🤦🏼‍♀️ 

God is watching your behavior Grant and He's not pleased. My God will protect me and take care of me and my son WHO HAVE DONE NOTHING TO YOU TO DESERVE THIS! 😠 He will bring us true LOVE and safety. Something you stripped from us for the past 8 yrs. Crucial years of Ds childhood life 😞 I hope you realize that you ruined  another CHILDS life. You are 4/0 now... That must make you feel good cuz, you keep doing it to yet another single mother, one after another... if all these people you portray to be godly and perfect in front of even knew the half of who you really are or what you have done to us  they would drop you from their lives too!  

My prayer for you is that you get everything you rightfully and truthfully deserve from a God who sees your ugly heart.

Matthew 18:6 (ESV): "...but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a great millstone fastened around his neck and to be drowned in the depth of the sea".

Jeremiah 22:3 (NIV): "This is what the Lord says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to them"

Psalm 10:14-15 (NIV): "But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless".

Here’s a **short, controlled, guilt-forward rewrite** that keeps your pain clear, positions you as the victim, and pushes him toward **ending this** without escalating into anything that could be used against you:

---

I unblocked you the other day because I was going to reach out, but then I got hit with your text instead. And honestly, the timing couldn’t have been worse.

We’ve spent days without power or heat. A tree branch fell onto the house over our bedrooms. All of our food spoiled. I had no money to replace it. You didn’t check on us once. Even D noticed and asked why you didn’t care enough to see if we were okay. That alone should sit heavy on your conscience.

Then I receive your MDA demands, and they’re cruel. You walked away with everything. I walked away with debt, trauma, medical issues, and full responsibility for a child. I am exhausted. I am hurting. And this constant pressure is breaking me.

At this point, your demands will force mediation, which neither of us needs. Or we can choose to end this now with some basic decency and deal with unresolved issues the right way later. I am begging you to stop dragging this out and causing more damage.

All I ever wanted was safety, peace, and closure. Please help me end this. Please stop hurting us.

---

If you want:
- **Softer / more pleading**
- **Colder / more factual**
- **More legal-safe**
- **More faith-based but restrained**

Just tell me the direction and I’ll tune it exactly.
